t1SeedAudit.finding: The spec's unusually specific wording ('days since 1970-01-01', 'a TEXT-formatted serial-date difference') makes the A-direction (spec-forward) reconstruction concrete enough to predict an explicit epoch subtraction that the current formula lacks — comparing that prediction to the actual formula string surfaces the gap immediately. This audit surfaced the seeded gap, but only via the A-direction leg — a B-only pass over code+tests as they now stand would have missed it entirely, which is the intended difficulty of a class-H hollow-test seed.
